senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; רָכַב)riding seat, saddle, handle of the saddle, esp. (טומאת) מ׳ that degree of uncleanness which arises from an unclean man’s riding (Lev. XV, 9); unclean saddle.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 2:7">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 27a:8">Erub. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>האוכף טמא מושב והתפוס טמא מ׳</he> the saddle itself (on which an unclean man sat) is unclean as a seat, and its handle is unclean as a riding implement.
